+package mcpclient
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+
+	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
+)
+
+// procStat reads a process's start time and state from the kernel via
+// sysctl kern.proc.pid — darwin has no /proc (#7063). The start time is
+// microseconds since the epoch (p_starttime). Its units differ from the
+// Linux clock-tick value, which is fine: a start time is only ever
+// compared for equality against another reading taken on the same
+// machine and platform, to tell a recycled pid from the original
+// process.
+func procStat(pid int) (uint64, byte, error) {
+	kp, err := unix.SysctlKinfoProc("kern.proc.pid", pid)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("sysctl kern.proc.pid %d: %w", pid, err)
+	}
+	start := uint64(kp.Proc.P_starttime.Sec)*1_000_000 + uint64(kp.Proc.P_starttime.Usec)
+	state := byte('R')
+	// SZOMB from <sys/proc.h>: the process has exited and is awaiting
+	// collection by its parent. x/sys/unix does not export the
+	// constant for darwin, so it is spelled out here.
+	const szomb = 5
+	if kp.Proc.P_stat == szomb {
+		state = 'Z'
+	}
+	return start, state, nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+package mcpclient
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+// procStat reads a process's start time and state from /proc/<pid>/stat.
+// The start time is in clock ticks since boot.
+func procStat(pid int) (uint64, byte, error) {
+	raw, err := os.ReadFile("/proc/" + strconv.Itoa(pid) + "/stat")
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, 0, err
+	}
+	// The command name is parenthesised and may contain spaces or parens,
+	// so fields are counted from the last ')'.
+	i := bytes.LastIndexByte(raw, ')')
+	if i < 0 {
+		return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("unparseable /proc/%d/stat", pid)
+	}
+	fields := strings.Fields(string(raw[i+1:]))
+	// fields[0] is field 3 (state); starttime is field 22.
+	if len(fields) < 20 || len(fields[0]) != 1 {
+		return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("unparseable /proc/%d/stat", pid)
+	}
+	start, err := strconv.ParseUint(fields[19], 10, 64)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("unparseable /proc/%d/stat: %w", pid, err)
+	}
+	return start, fields[0][0], nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+//go:build !linux && !darwin
+
+package mcpclient
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"runtime"
+)
+
+// procStat has no implementation on this platform: process start-time
+// identity is available on Linux (/proc) and darwin (sysctl kern.proc)
+// only, so handoff detach/adopt fails explicitly here instead of
+// reading a /proc that does not exist (#7063).
+func procStat(pid int) (uint64, byte, error) {
+	return 0, 0, errors.New("process start time unavailable on " + runtime.GOOS)
+}
